_comment: Every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
DATA    = anything a real run produced. Never in this repo.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py from the fleet-guards checkout (git config fleet.guards) through .githooks.
_audited: 2026-11-25 AUDIT at repo creation. BaiduNetdiskDebloat.ps1 writes only to the Baidu Netdisk install under %APPDATA%\baidu\BaiduNetdisk, the registry (Baidu's own keys, Explorer's Blocked list, Office and browser policies), Windows Firewall rules, one service's start type, Windows notification settings, a scheduled task, and its own state folder %ProgramData%\AppDebloat\baidunetdisk (journal.jsonl, options.json, state.json, auto.log, history.log, backup\, regkeys\, an installed copy of the script). Every one of those paths is outside any git worktree, and the script never writes to a path relative to itself or to this repo. So the empty data list is an audited conclusion, not a default.
